market.domesticSlice: India API market: $13.60B (2024) to $21.99B by 2030 (CAGR 8.30%) per Vantage Market Research; a second estimate: $16.01B (2026) to $27.62B by 2033 (CAGR 8.1%). India hosts 650+ USFDA-approved manufacturing plants (most of any country outside the US), supplies 40%+ of US generic drugs and 25% of UK medicines.

structureFacts: China+1 sourcing shift: China controls ~80% of global generic-drug API supply, but India itself sources roughly two-thirds of its own API needs (70-90% of KSMs/basic APIs) from China — so India's 'China+1' positioning carries its own upstream dependency, not a clean substitution story

India's PLI scheme for APIs: ₹6,940 Cr budget (approved 2020), ~21 projects sanctioned for 35 critical APIs that previously accounted for ~67% of India's import dependence, combined installed capacity 33,895 tonnes; separate ₹3,000 Cr Bulk Drug Parks scheme (Himachal Pradesh, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh)
Regulatory approval cycles (DMF/CEP filings, USFDA/EU-GMP audits) are a multi-year gating process, not a fast-moving competitive variable

adoptionStructure.note: Not a seasonal-repurchase category; demand is qualification-and-contract driven — a 12-24+ month buyer qualification/audit cycle typically precedes a new API sourcing relationship, after which orders recur on a multi-year supply-contract basis
